messages:
deploy-bot: starting v2 rollout at 25% (NA/EU). release rl-2026-06-v2-03. ramp=25->60 in 25m with 5m pauses.

jia: note - this flips on X-API-Version header. requests without header stay on v1 via temporary shim; shim is intended to be short-lived.

tom: please add rollback triggers: 5xx >=1.5% for 3m OR p95 >350ms for 10m. ops, confirm.

ops-oncall: confirmed. also alert if `shim_mapped_to_v1` > 8% for 30m for tenant-slice. we'll pin tenants above 12% missing header.

release-coordinator: drafting release notes; will call out header, shim timeline (14 days max), and pin procedure.

jia: quick example for notes:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-API-Version: 2" \
  -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate
```

ops-oncall: metrics snapshot after first ramp: 5xx=0.0009 p95=210ms shim_mapped_to_v1=6.5% header_missing_pct=5.9%. holding watch.

tom: if we need an emergency rollback runbook: (1) deploybot rollback rl-2026-06-v2-03, (2) pin affected tenants, (3) notify CS and affected customers. keep it in the runbook page.

release-coordinator: added runbook checklist and links to the draft release note. marking rollout state=monitoring.
